## 🧠 About Me

I'm a **Master 2 student in Big Data & Cloud Computing** based in **Casablanca, Morocco**, currently looking for a **PFE internship**. I'm passionate about designing **data pipelines**, building scalable **data platforms** and developing **intelligent applications** that turn raw data into meaningful insights.

My interests span **Data Engineering, Big Data, Data Analytics, Data Science, Cloud Computing** and **Artificial Intelligence** — with a focus on reliable architecture, clean code and continuous learning.
